_readme: Indoor kids' play zone and family cafe over two levels. Source deck exports are NOT
committed. No redaction ops: the views chosen carry no venue name.
Several other views were excluded rather than patched, because the venue's name is
part of the themed signage in the design itself - a marquee pillar on the pretend-play
street and a cafe shopfront. Patching signage that is a designed element would falsify
the design, so those frames are simply not used.

play-street.alt: Indoor pretend-play street with shopfronts, a clock tower, traffic lights and a train overhead
play-street.caption: The pretend-play street: shopfronts, kerbs, crossings and a clock tower, with the train running above. Indicative viewpoint.

base-level-plan.alt: Base level plan of a children's play centre marking play zones, cafe, kitchen and toilets
base-level-plan.caption: Base level: cafe and kitchen at the entrance, toddlers' area and trampoline room to one side, the RC arenas, super climber and pretend-play street across the floor.

mezzanine-level-plan.alt: Mezzanine level plan showing library, art and sand tables, play farm and party space
mezzanine-level-plan.caption: Mezzanine: the quieter half — library, lego and block area, sand and art tables, play farm, and the party space that pays for the floor.

key-plan.alt: Key plan and part plan drawing locating the reception area within the wider floor
key-plan.caption: Every view in the deck is tied back to a key plan, so a client can see exactly where they are standing.

construction-zone.alt: Indoor sand play area with toy diggers and dumper trucks beside a play street
construction-zone.caption: The construction zone: sand, ride-on diggers and a raised kerb that keeps sand off the street. Indicative viewpoint.

off-road-landscape.alt: Raised landscape play table with toy vehicles beside a wall of coloured ball storage
off-road-landscape.caption: A modelled landscape for ride-on vehicles, with ball storage stacked as a wall. Indicative viewpoint.

play-farm.alt: Indoor play farm with model sheep, a fruit tree mural and a train carriage alongside
play-farm.caption: The play farm on the mezzanine, with the train passing its fence. Indicative viewpoint.

soft-play.alt: Soft play room with padded wall discs, low benches and a cushioned floor mat
soft-play.caption: Soft play: padded discs at toddler height, a raised mat, and nothing with a hard edge. Indicative viewpoint.

soft-play-alt.alt: Soft play area with pastel wall panels and a bench seat for accompanying parents
soft-play-alt.caption: Bench seating for the parent who has to sit within arm's reach. Indicative viewpoint.

family-cafe.alt: Family cafe with arched windows, terrazzo flooring, timber tables and a spiral stair
family-cafe.caption: The family cafe: arched glazing, terrazzo underfoot and a spiral stair to the play level. Indicative viewpoint.

cafe-window-seating.alt: Cafe seating along a run of arched windows with pendant lighting above the tables
cafe-window-seating.caption: Seating runs along the window line, so a waiting parent gets daylight and a view out. Indicative viewpoint.

cafe-counter.alt: Cafe interior with a curved counter, cloud-shaped ceiling elements and banquette seating
cafe-counter.caption: Cloud forms carry from the play floor into the cafe, so the two halves read as one venue. Indicative viewpoint.
